title: Offboarding hand-over: owner_id entries follow the object-level Change Owner switch (userActions.transfer)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbSphdunq2aJq7ktuY

Split from #35344 by seat 5 (area ux-1) on the seat's word. ⛔ Not a claim. #35344 ships only its interim (`controlled_by_parent` details are left out of the hand-over); this card is the rest of its Expected.

Blocked-by: #35315 (introduces the object-level switch `userActions.transfer` and its derived default; this card reads the same predicate)

## What remains

- The offboarding hand-over roster's `owner_id` entries (`userAssignedWorkFields`, `packages/core/src/security/user-assigned-work.ts`) follow #35315's object-level switch: off by derived default for `controlled_by_parent` details, on otherwise, author-overridable. An object whose switch is off does not hand its `owner_id` over.
- The panel still counts those records, so the admin knows they exist.
- App-authored user fields (assignee, approver) are unchanged.

## Done when

The roster reads #35315's predicate (one rule, no second copy); pins for switch on, switch off, derived default on a detail, and an app-authored user field untouched; the #35344 interim pin keeps passing or is subsumed with a note.

Dedupe words: offboarding owner_id userActions.transfer, user-assigned-work transfer switch, hand-over owner switch.
